overview_description.description: Procore is a software company that provides cloud-based construction management software. Procore's software platform is designed to streamline various aspects of construction project management and collaboration, from project planning and document management to financial tracking and communication among project stakeholders. Procore is widely used in the construction industry to improve project efficiency, reduce errors, and enhance collaboration among project stakeholders. It is suitable for a wide range of construction projects, from small residential developments to large-scale commercial and infrastructure projects.

about_short_description.short_description: Procore is a cloud-based management software that helps to simplify project execution and management tasks for construction sectors.

product.name: Procore Platform
product.description: A cloud-based construction management platform that connects project teams, field operations, financial data, documents, and workflows across the construction lifecycle.

product.name: Procore AI
product.description: An embedded construction AI capability that searches project information, generates drafts, identifies risks, and automates routine workflows using project data and documents.

product.name: Procore Project Management
product.description: Construction project management software for coordinating documents, communications, schedules, field activities, and project information between office and jobsite teams.

product.name: Procore Bid Management
product.description: A bid-management solution for creating bid packages, inviting trade partners, comparing proposals, tracking coverage, and converting selected bids into contracts or purchase orders.

product.name: Procore Cost Management
product.description: Construction cost-management capabilities that provide real-time visibility into budgets, commitments, change events, contracts, costs, and forecasted project financial results.

product.name: Procore Project Financials
product.description: Financial management tools for maintaining project budgets, commitments, contracts, change orders, direct costs, and forecasts throughout construction.
